title: Panel Discussion: Regulation and Policy Frameworks for Critical Minerals
gist: The text is a member-only video listing page, not a transcript: a 35-minute Giga Africa 2026 panel on regulatory frameworks, policies and incentives for EV batteries and critical minerals in Africa, with Benchmark's Adam Panayi, the Africa Battery Initiative, Global Battery Alliance, assayer Alfred H Knight and KG Energy Infrastructure. No positions are captured.

themes.theme: Policy and incentives for African battery value chains

insights.claim: The panel focuses on how regulation, policy and strategic incentives are shaping growth in EV batteries and critical minerals across Africa.
insights.speaker: Inga Petersen, Executive Director, Global Battery Alliance
insights.so_what: Policy design (incentives, local beneficiation rules) is a key determinant of where African battery investment lands.
insights.quote: Regulatory frameworks, policies, and strategic incentives shaping growth in EV batteries and critical minerals across Africa.

insights.claim: The inclusion of the Global Battery Alliance and testing/inspection firm Alfred H Knight signals traceability and verification standards are part of the African critical-minerals regulatory debate.
insights.speaker: Inga Petersen, Executive Director, Global Battery Alliance
insights.so_what: Traceability (e.g. battery passport-style regimes) could become a market-access requirement for African material.
insights.quote: Maxime Francois , Regional General Manager - Africa & Middle East Company , Alfred H Knight

insights.claim: An African continental battery advocacy body, the Africa Battery Initiative, and an energy infrastructure developer were on the panel alongside global standard-setters.
insights.speaker: Inga Petersen, Executive Director, Global Battery Alliance
insights.so_what: African industry bodies are seeking a seat in setting the rules that govern their minerals' access to export markets.
insights.quote: Alawi Swabury , CEO , Africa Battery Initiative (ABI)

source_meta.author: Adam Panayi , Chief Research Officer , Benchmark Mineral Intelligence; Alawi Swabury , CEO , Africa Battery Initiative (
